title: Locality of the 3-clause encoding of a single clause
statement: Fix a clause index $i$ and let $C$ be a clause over a variable type $V$. If a 3-clause occurs in the list produced by encoding $C$ at index $i$, then each of its three literals is local to $i$; that is, every auxiliary variable appearing in the 3-clause carries the index $i$, while literals over original variables of $V$ are local automatically.
hypotheses_covered: C is a clause over variable type V
the 3-clause is a member of the encoding transformClause i C
replaced:
Every literal in any 3-clause produced by $\texttt{SATTo3SAT.transformClause}\,i\,\mathit{clause}$
is local to index $i$.
